name: Johann Andreas Grub
bioAdditions: The original Reichenbach Lutheran baptism register (page 93, year 1727), attached as an image to his FamilySearch profile, settles the birth date: under 'd. 12t 7br' [12 September] it records that Nickel Grub and his wife of Jettenbach had a son born, baptized on the 21st of the same month and named Joh. Andreas (S1). The godparents included Maria Catharina, wife of Peter Grub, and Maria Elisabetha, wife of Adam Wendel. This confirms the 12 September date given by WikiTree and FamilySearch and rules out the 12 July of the GEDBAS database; the 12 December on his gravestone is presumably a misreading of '7ber' or '12br'.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Birth now read in the original register; marriage, will naming Frederick, and widow's will naming 'son Frederick Krub' already documented.
